build_provenance.test_structure: Standalone test includes implementation. Do not additionally link the implementation into that test.
build_provenance.comparison_method: Compile C++ with -ffunction-sections. Link only newly compiled object at original function VAs, assign external dependency symbols their observed absolute target VAs, then compare full function bytes using ELF symbol sizes. No reference ELF is a linker input; no masking, copied instructions or opcode substitutions.
build_provenance.comparison_link_limit: Test-only address assignment is required for PC-relative branch byte equality. The linked comparison artifact is not a production executable and cannot provide the missing billing implementations. Original compiler version/options and original source types remain unknown.

differential.scope: Adapters only; billing targets and JNI V callback are modeled. Checks argument/result bits, call count, reference mutation, restored stack and ARM callee-saved registers. No JVM, billing implementation, exceptions or game integration.

sanitizers.leak_detection: NOT RUN; disabled for sandbox-compatible ASan/UBSan execution.

negative_checks.result: PASS: disabled assertions rejected before verification

uncertainties_and_exclusions: Original return types of three billing callees are not encoded in these mangled names or tail branches. Word preserves ARM32 r0 bits; no claim of original bool, pointer, enum or void type. Additional return registers are not modeled.
IAB_STORE_ITEM layout is opaque. The source uses a reference, and only test-local StoreItem storage is defined. No billing, allocation, ownership or item-format implementation is supplied.
Environment/NativeInterface are source-owned minimal JNI views. Full jni.h type identity, original C++ symbols, Android registration and application integration remain UNVERIFIED.

Variadic cases require signature-correct promoted arguments. Corpus covers no args, int, pointer, double, signed 64-bit, mixed alignment/stack args and twelve ints with 69 seeds per signature. It is bounded evidence, not an exhaustive JNI proof.
JNI exception propagation, VM behavior, real billing state, malformed tables, mismatched variadic types and concurrent calls are not tested. No success stubs replace missing game logic.
JNI adapter code uses a different compiler prologue/call sequence; explicitly NOT MATCHED despite passing differential cases.

failures_and_corrections.result: Unicorn/QEMU memory-section assertion when one mapping was created for every ELF page.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Coalesced adjacent ELF pages into ranges. Final complete reproduction passed twice with 690 differential cases and identical transcript hash.
